artNote: Original illustrations for 12과 are still to be drawn, so no question carries art yet. None of them needs one to be answerable: every question is about a form the chapter prints, a word on its 어휘 or 미용실 pages, the 붕어빵 of its culture page or its 받침 ㄻ rule — and one of them, 젊게 보여요, is there to say that a form the chapter does not practise is still good Korean.

questions.q: What does 좋아 보여요 say that 좋아요 does not?

choices.A: that the speaker has already tried it
choices.B: that the speaker is judging by how it looks
choices.C: that it used to be good but no longer is
choices.D: nothing — the two say the same thing

questions.q: 먹어 봐요 and 맛있어 보여요 both have a 보 in them. What does each one say?

choices.B: 먹어 봐요 is it looks edible; 맛있어 보여요 is try it
choices.D: 먹어 봐요 is try eating it; 맛있어 보여요 is it looks tasty

questions.q: Next to 젊어 보여요, is 젊게 보여요 wrong?
Which of these says “looks like a university student”?
인형 ___ 생겼어요 and 인형 ___ 얼굴: which pair fills the two gaps?
Why is 가수처럼 written closed up, but 가수 같은 사람 with a space?

choices.C: 처럼 is a particle; 같은 is 같다
choices.D: either may be written either way

questions.q: Which of these takes -는 편이다 rather than -(으)ㄴ 편이다?
말이 없다 and 재미있다 take which ending before 편이에요?
Why is it 마른 편이에요 when 마르다 is a verb?

choices.B: 마른 is just another spelling of 마르는
choices.C: being thin is the result of 마르다
choices.D: the 르 irregular turns 마르는 into 마른

questions.q: In 조용한 편이에요, what kind of word is 편?

choices.A: a noun meaning side, plus 이다

questions.q: Why does 귀엽다 keep its ㅂ in 귀엽게 but not in 귀여워요?

choices.D: ㅂ changes only before a vowel

questions.q: How is 짧게 pronounced, as in 더워서 짧게 잘랐어요?
받침 ㄻ before a consonant, as in 젊네요, leaves which sound?
How is 닮았어요 pronounced in 켈리 씨는 누구를 닮았어요?
A Korean friend looks at your family photo and says 완전히 붕어빵이네. What do they mean?

choices.A: that you look like someone in it
choices.B: that the photo makes them feel hungry
choices.C: that everyone in it has a round face
choices.D: that the photo was taken in winter

questions.q: At the hair salon, which of these asks only for a trim?
Someone reads alone while everyone around them chats. Their personality is most likely —
